content.text: {"id": "mm6850a7", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "The rate of ED visits with a primary diagnosis or primary complaint of substance abuse or dependence by patients aged 18–34 years"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "increased from 45.4 visits per 10,000 persons in 2008–2009 to 76.0 visits in 2016–2017"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "count/rate", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "increased from 45.4 visits per 10,000 persons in 2008–2009 to 76.0 visits in 2016–2017"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "remained stable among patients aged ≥35 years (27.2 in 2008–2009 and 24.6 in 2016–2017)"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "In both periods, persons aged 18–34 years were more likely to visit the ED for substance abuse or dependence than those aged ≥35 years."}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "cross-sectional", "ev": [{"loc": "note", "q": "Based on a sample of visits to emergency departments (EDs) in noninstitutional general and short-stay hospitals"}]}, {"v": "before/after or trend", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "increased from 45.4 visits per 10,000 persons in 2008–2009 to 76.0 visits in 2016–2017"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "note", "q": "95% confidence intervals are indicated with error bars."}], "confidence": "high", "uncertain_fields": []}
